description: This Java class 'ScheduleGeneratorDTO' serves as a Data Transfer Object for loan schedule generation, encapsulating various parameters and configurations related to loan repayment scheduling, interest calculation, and calendar considerations within the Fineract platform.

classes.name: ScheduleGeneratorDTO
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object encapsulating parameters for generating loan repayment schedules, including calendar, interest, and repayment configurations.

methods.name: getLoanScheduleFactory
methods.description: Returns the factory used to generate loan schedules.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Returns the currency data associated with the loan.

methods.name: getCalculatedRepaymentsStartingFromDate
methods.description: Returns the date from which repayment calculations start.

methods.name: getCalendarInstanceForInterestRecalculation
methods.description: Returns the calendar instance used for interest recalculation.

methods.name: getRecalculateFrom
methods.description: Returns the start date for recalculations.

methods.name: getRecalculateTill
methods.description: Returns the end date for recalculations.

methods.name: getOverdurPenaltyWaitPeriod
methods.description: Returns the wait period for overdue penalties.

methods.name: getPenaltyWaitPeriod
methods.description: Returns the penalty wait period as an integer.

methods.name: getHolidayDetailDTO
methods.description: Returns holiday details related to schedule generation.

methods.name: setRecalculateFrom
methods.description: Sets the start date for recalculations.

methods.name: getCompoundingCalendarInstance
methods.description: Returns the calendar instance used for interest compounding.

methods.name: getFloatingRateDTO
methods.description: Returns the floating rate data.

methods.name: getCalendar
methods.description: Returns the calendar used for schedule generation.

methods.name: getCalendarHistoryDataWrapper
methods.description: Returns the calendar history data wrapper.

methods.name: isInterestChargedFromDateAsDisbursementDateEnabled
methods.description: Indicates if interest is charged from the disbursement date.

methods.name: getNumberOfdays
methods.description: Returns the number of days parameter.

methods.name: isSkipRepaymentOnFirstDayofMonth
methods.description: Indicates if repayment should be skipped on the first day of the month.

methods.name: isChangeEmiIfRepaymentDateSameAsDisbursementDateEnabled
methods.description: Indicates if EMI should be changed if repayment date is same as disbursement date.

methods.name: isFirstRepaymentDateAllowedOnHoliday
methods.description: Indicates if first repayment date can be on a holiday.

methods.name: isInterestToBeRecoveredFirstWhenGreaterThanEMI
methods.description: Indicates if interest should be recovered first when greater than EMI.

methods.name: isPrincipalCompoundingDisabledForOverdueLoans
methods.description: Indicates if principal compounding is disabled for overdue loans.
